Instructions

Preparation: Step on the pedals with feet evenly placed, grip the moving handles. Start with a smooth easy pace to find the stride rhythm.

1

Stand tall; keep both feet on pedals.

2

Keep both feet planted in the pedals.

3

Coordinate your push and pull with legs.

4

Hold both grips; keep your chest tall.

5

Return smoothly to the first shown stride.

6

Keep your torso tall without leaning forward.
